uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser

raw_text:
Telegram bot template: aiogram 3, Django 5, Celery; `/start`, automatic user tracking.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

Required `.env`: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY`; optional `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`. Celery requires Redis. Admin: `/admin`. Production use requires secret management and database configuration.

`main.py` initializes Django ORM, aiogram Bot/Dispatcher, middleware/routes, polling. Add handlers to `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or routers included in `main.py:42`; models to `bot/models.py`, register in `bot/admin.py`; tasks to `bot/tasks.py` using the `<REDACTED_USER>_task` decorator. Add environment variables to `.env.example` and access them via `config/settings.py`.
